title: 第6章 食物和水
slug: 班级地铁求生全班就我一个男生
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

随着系统提示音，车厢正中央的地板上裂开，缓缓升起一台老式电脑。

电脑屏幕光标跳跃，显示有三个界面。

聊天频道。

交易行。

地铁升级面板。

秦守最感兴趣的是“地铁升级面板”。

只见界面区域显示着一个三维线框模型——正是这列地铁的微缩图。

模型下方列着可升级项目：引擎系统、装甲系统、能源核心、功能车厢。

每一项都是灰色，显示缺乏对应升级蓝图，不可升级。

“聊天频道开了！”

陆小小兴奋地凑到电脑屏幕前，脸几乎贴了上去。

“终于可以和其他人联系了。”

只见聊天频道消息滚动的速度快得惊人，无数文字互相堆叠、覆盖、冲撞。

【有人吗有人吗有人吗——我们车厢死了三个人！初始站台里全是那种灰白色的怪物！太可怕了！】

【我们这边有两个人被拖进洗手间，再也没出来！】

【我们的初始站台是个废弃医院，里面根本没有洗手间，只有太平间。太平间里好像有东西在动，我们没敢进去。】

【我们站台上全是雾，伸手不见五指，有队员进去了，再也没出来。】

【啊啊啊啊，太可怕了，妈妈，我想回家！】

【楼上别想了，我们回不去了，只能跟着地铁去下一站。】

【下一站是什么？系统说完成了初始站台，但没说下一站是什么。】

【我们车厢有个人在初始站台捡到了一张纸，上面写着“本站台仅为基础站台”，后面还有字，但被撕掉了。】

【基础站台？也就是说后面是更高级的站台？我们在初始站台死了三个人，更高级的站台是不是要死更多？】

聊天频道短暂地沉默了一瞬，随即被一条新消息打破。

【兄弟们，我肚子饿了，好饿好饿！】

【我也饿了，这鬼地方连口水都没得喝，地铁里还没厕所，只能就地解决。】

【楼上你是来搞笑的吗？不过我也饿了，有没有人身上带吃的？我们车厢十个人，全光着身子，什么都没有。】

【一样！开局光着身子，连块布都没有。】

【楼上你们好惨——不过我们也好不到哪去。我们车厢有个人的背包跟着一起进了游戏，里面有三包饼干。十个人分三包饼干，每个人分到一小块。我那块三秒钟就吃完了，现在更饿了。】

消息滚动的速度越来越快，饥饿像某种传染病，迅速在聊天频道里蔓延开来。

有人在哀嚎，有人在求吃的。

陆小小盯着屏幕看了半天，忽然揉了揉自己的肚子。

“被他们说得我也饿了。”

顾佳佳抱着膝盖蹲在座椅上。

“我也是。”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

As the system beeped, the floor in the center of the carriage cracked, and an old-fashioned computer slowly rose up.

The cursor jumps on the computer screen, showing three interfaces.

Chat channel.

Trading line.

Metro upgrade panel.

What Qin Shou is most interested in is the "subway upgrade panel".

I saw a three-dimensional wireframe model displayed in the interface area-it was a miniature of this subway train.

Upgradeable items are listed below the model: engine system, armor system, energy core, and functional compartment.

Each item is gray, indicating that it lacks a corresponding upgrade blueprint and cannot be upgraded.

"The chat channel is open!"

Lu Xiaoxiao excitedly approached the computer screen, his face almost touching it.

“I can finally connect with other people.”

I saw the chat channel messages scrolling at an alarming speed, with countless words stacked, covering, and colliding with each other.

[Is there anyone? Is anyone there? Three people died in our carriage!The initial platform is full of those gray-white monsters!How terrible!】

[Two people on our side were dragged into the bathroom and never came out again!】

[Our initial site is an abandoned hospital. There are no restrooms at all, only a morgue.There seemed to be something moving in the morgue, so we didn't dare to go in.】

[Our platform was covered with fog, and I couldn’t see my fingers. Some team members went in and never came out again.】

[Ahhhhh, it’s so scary, Mom, I want to go home!】

[Don’t think about upstairs, we can’t go back, we can only follow the subway to the next stop.】

【What's the next stop?The system said that the initial station was completed, but it did not say what the next station was.】

[Someone in our carriage picked up a piece of paper at the initial platform, which said "This platform is only a basic platform". There were words on the back, but they were torn off.】

[Basic platform?In other words, is there a more advanced platform behind it?We had three people die on the initial platform. Will there be more deaths on more advanced platforms?】

The chat channel was silent for a brief moment, and then was broken by a new message.

[Brothers, I’m hungry, so hungry!】

[I'm hungry too. You don't even have a drink of water in this damn place. There are no toilets in the subway, so we have to deal with it on the spot.】

[Are you here to make fun of me upstairs?But I'm hungry too. Does anyone have anything to eat?There were ten people in our carriage, all naked and without anything.】

【Same!At the beginning, he was naked, not even a piece of cloth.】

[It’s so miserable for you upstairs—but we’re not much better.Someone’s backpack in our carriage followed us into the game, and there were three packets of biscuits in it.Ten people were given three packages of biscuits, and each person got a small piece.I finished my piece in three seconds, and now I'm even hungrier.】

The messages scrolled faster and faster, and hunger quickly spread in the chat channel like some kind of contagious disease.

Some were wailing and some were begging for food.

Lu Xiaoxiao stared at the screen for a long time and suddenly rubbed his belly.

"They made me hungry too."

Gu Jiajia squatted on the seat holding her knees.

"Me too."
